defs.def: happening all the time or repeatedly 连续发生的；不断的；重复的

ex.s: Toby was his constant companion, the one who kept him going.
“You don’t want to get fat” was on constant repeat throughout my childhood.
ex.t: 没有人确切知道这个黑箱内部发生了什么。

ex.s: The thing is, regular exercise to get “in shape” requires constant and considerable effort — all for gradual progress and uncertain rewards.
ex.t: 在以下哪个日期你可以取消报名并获得全额退款？

ex.s: I worked extensively with other students, constantly asked questions, and helped with ongoing projects to learn everything I could.
ex.t: 我与其他学生广泛合作，不断提问，并参与正在进行的项目以学习一切我能学到的。

ex.s: There are alternatives to constant written communication, such as leaving voice messages or having a group chat.
ex.t: 除了持续的文字交流，还有别的选择，比如留语音消息或建群聊。

ex.s: For almost a year I struggled on, constantly staring at this wall that faced me.
ex.t: 差不多一年，我都在挣扎，不停地盯着面前这堵墙。

ex.s: In a wired world with constant global communication, we're all positioned to see flashes of genius wherever they appear.
ex.t: 在一个有线连接、全球沟通不断的世界里，我们都有机会看到天才的闪光，无论出现在哪里。
人们的注意力经常走神。

ex.s: The question of what we know and do not know constantly bothered me.
ex.t: 然而，当我思考Juan的问题时，我不确定我们还能排除多少可能性。

ex.s: Self-talk is a constant stream of thoughts of a person, who is often unaware and uncertain of some events, phenomena, people, or even the person himself.
ex.t: 自我对话是一个人不间断的思想流，他往往对一些事件、现象、人、甚至自己都缺乏觉察和确定。

ex.s: “For example, most of us would expect older drivers always go slower than everyone else but surprisingly, we found that in 30mph zones they struggled to keep at a constant speed and so were more likely to break the speed limit and be at risk of getting fined.
ex.t: “例如，我们大多数人都以为老年驾驶者总是比其他人开得慢，但令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在限速30英里每小时的区域，他们难以保持匀速，因此更有可能超速并被罚款的风险。

ex.s: We are therefore not talking about adapting to a new standard, but to a constantly shifting set of conditions.
ex.t: 因此我们谈论的不是去适应一个新的标准，而是去适应一组不断变化的条件。

ex.s: Second, if other factors such as technology remain constant, economic growth and material expectations will fall well below recent standards and this could invite trouble.
ex.t: 其次，如果技术等其他因素保持不变，经济增长和物质期望将远低于近期标准，这可能引发麻烦。

ex.s: New kinds of crimes are happening on the Internet, too, so cyber security has to be constantly updated.
ex.t: 互联网上也出现了新型犯罪，因此网络安全必须不断更新。

defs.def: that does not change 不变的；固定的；恒定的

ex.s: By the fifth day, I wondered-was I really missing out by not constantly checking my phone to see what everyone else was up to?
ex.t: 到了第五天，我在想——我真的错过了什么吗？我不再不停地查看手机，看别人都在做什么。

ex.s: He is constantly worried about his health and wants a quiet, simple life.
ex.t: 他经常担心自己的健康，想要过平静简单的生活。

ex.s: It is for this reason that the WWF constantly information to stir up public interest in the welfare of the planet.
ex.t: 正是出于这个原因，世界自然基金会不断发布信息，以激发公众对地球福祉的兴趣。

ex.s: They must have to constantly their .
ex.t: 他们必须不断调整自己的策略。
